# Maester / NCSC Control Mapping

Shared, growing reference used by the `terraform-security-baseline-auditor` skill. Each row maps a control area to
verified Maester test IDs and NCSC/Microsoft guidance, regardless of which `terraform/*.tf` file the control applies
to. When auditing a new file, check for existing rows before adding new ones, and only add rows for
IDs/links verified via a live fetch during that audit.

| Area / Control | Maester Test ID(s) | Maester Test Name & Purpose | NCSC / Microsoft Alignment | Official Reference Link | Audited Terraform File(s) |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Legacy Method Retirement (SMS/Voice)** | `EIDSCA.AS04`<br>`EIDSCA.AV01`<br>`CISA.MS.AAD.3.5` | **Authentication Method - SMS/Voice - State**<br><br>Confirms SMS and Voice call sign-in stay disabled. | **NCSC Authentication methods and phishing resistance**<br><br>*"Avoid SMS as a primary sign-in factor; consider MFA or passwordless options instead."* | [NCSC Phishing-Resistant Auth](https://www.ncsc.gov.uk/blog-post/authentication-methods-and-phishing-resistance) | `terraform/authentication-method-policies.tf` |
| **Phishing-Resistant MFA (FIDO2)** | `EIDSCA.AF01`<br>`EIDSCA.AF03` | **Authentication Method - FIDO2 - State / Enforce attestation**<br><br>Confirms FIDO2 is enabled with attestation enforced. | **NCSC Zero Trust Principle 3: User Identity**<br><br>*"Protect privileged users with phishing-resistant, cryptographic authentication mechanisms."* | [NCSC Identity & Access](https://www.ncsc.gov.uk/guidance/zero-trust-architecture-point-3) | `terraform/authentication-method-policies.tf` |
| **Privileged Role Phishing-Resistant MFA** | `CISA.MS.AAD.3.6` | **Phishing-resistant MFA SHALL be required for highly privileged roles**<br><br>Enforced via Conditional Access authentication strength. | **NCSC MFA Guidance**<br><br>*"MFA must be configured for all users accessing cloud services, with stronger assurance for privileged access."* | [NCSC MFA Guidance](https://www.ncsc.gov.uk/guidance/multi-factor-authentication-for-your-corporate-services) | `terraform/conditional-access.tf`, `terraform/authentication-method-policies.tf` |
| **MFA Fatigue / Push-Bombing Resistance** | `EIDSCA.AM01`<br>`EIDSCA.AM09`<br>`CISA.MS.AAD.3.3` | **Microsoft Authenticator - State / Show geographic location**<br><br>Confirms Authenticator push prompts show sign-in context to reduce accidental approvals. | **Microsoft Entra authentication overview**<br><br>*"Configure Authenticator to display context information to users when they log in."* | [Manage authentication methods](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/entra/identity/authentication/concept-authentication-methods-manage) | `terraform/authentication-method-policies.tf` |
| **Bootstrap Credential Hygiene (TAP)** | `EIDSCA.AT01`<br>`EIDSCA.AT02` | **Temporary Access Pass - State / One-time**<br><br>Confirms TAP is single-use and short-lived when enabled. | **Microsoft Entra authentication overview**<br><br>*"Temporary Access Pass bootstraps registration of stronger methods; it should not be a standing credential."* | [Microsoft Entra authentication overview](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/entra/identity/authentication/overview-authentication) | `terraform/authentication-method-policies.tf` |
| **Policy Migration Completeness** | `CISA.MS.AAD.3.4` | **Authentication Methods Manage Migration feature SHALL be set to Migration Complete**<br><br>Confirms the root policy's `policyMigrationState` stays `migrationComplete` so legacy MFA/SSPR policies can't override it. | **Microsoft Entra authentication overview**<br><br>*"Legacy MFA and SSPR policies are deprecated; migrate fully to the Authentication Methods Policy."* | [Manage authentication methods](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/entra/identity/authentication/concept-authentication-methods-manage) | `terraform/authentication-method-policies.tf` |
| **Guest-Scoped Weak Methods (Email OTP)** | `CISA.MS.AAD.3.5`<br>`MT.1067` | **SMS, Voice Call, and Email OTP SHALL be disabled** *(with a documented guest-only deviation for Email OTP)*<br>**Authentication methods policies should not reference deleted groups** | **NCSC Zero Trust Principle 3: User Identity**<br><br>*"Scope weaker authentication methods away from the general workforce."* | [NCSC Identity & Access](https://www.ncsc.gov.uk/guidance/zero-trust-architecture-point-3) | `terraform/authentication-method-policies.tf`, `terraform/security-groups.tf` |
| **Emergency Access (Break-Glass)** | `MT.1001`<br>`MT.1002` | **GlobalAdminsExcludedFromCA / EmergencyAccessExcluded**<br><br>Verifies break-glass accounts are excluded from standard restrictive policies to prevent lockouts. | **Principle 3: User Identity**<br><br>*"Ensure administrative accounts have fallback access mechanisms, but strictly monitor them."* | [NCSC Identity & Access](https://www.ncsc.gov.uk/guidance/zero-trust-architecture-point-3) | `terraform/conditional-access.tf` |
| **Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA)** | `MT.1010`<br>`MT.1011` | **RequireMFAForAllUsers**<br><br>Checks that a baseline CA policy enforces MFA across all cloud applications. | **Principle 3 & Cyber Essentials**<br><br>*"MFA must be configured for all users accessing cloud services."* | [NCSC MFA Guidance](https://www.ncsc.gov.uk/guidance/multi-factor-authentication-for-your-corporate-services) | `terraform/conditional-access.tf` |
| **Phishing-Resistant MFA (Admins, CA layer)** | `MT.1015`<br>`MT.1016` | **RequirePhishingResistantMFAForAdmins**<br><br>Verifies administrators use authentication strengths (FIDO2, CBA) rather than weak SMS/Voice. | **Principle 3: Identity**<br><br>*"Protect privileged users with phishing-resistant, cryptographic authentication mechanisms."* | [NCSC Phishing-Resistant Auth](https://www.ncsc.gov.uk/blog-post/authentication-methods-and-phishing-resistance) | `terraform/conditional-access.tf` |
| **Legacy Authentication** | `MT.1020` | **BlockLegacyAuthentication**<br><br>Tests that client app types `other` and `exchangeActiveSync` are explicitly blocked. | **Cyber Essentials / Baseline Security**<br><br>*"Disable legacy protocols that do not support multi-factor authentication."* | [NCSC Device / Cloud Security](https://www.ncsc.gov.uk/collection/cloud-security/implementing-the-cloud-security-principles/principle-10) | `terraform/conditional-access.tf` |
| **Device Compliance & Health** | `MT.1030`<br>`MT.1031` | **RequireCompliantDeviceOrHybridJoined**<br><br>Verifies policies require managed, health-attested devices for sensitive app access. | **Principle 4: Device Health**<br><br>*"Only allow trusted, compliant devices with validated health posture to access enterprise data."* | [NCSC Device Integrity](https://www.ncsc.gov.uk/guidance/zero-trust-architecture-point-4) | `terraform/conditional-access.tf` |
| **Risk-Based Access (Identity Protection)** | `MT.1040`<br>`MT.1041` | **BlockHighRiskSignIns / RequireMFAForMediumRisk**<br><br>Evaluates sign-in and user risk levels using automated real-time identity protection. | **Principle 7: Signals & Policy Engine**<br><br>*"Incorporate dynamic contextual signals (user and sign-in risk) into access decisions."* | [NCSC Policy Engine Guidance](https://www.ncsc.gov.uk/guidance/zero-trust-architecture-point-7) | `terraform/conditional-access.tf` |
| **Session Control & Token Lifetime** | `MT.1050` | **RequireSignInFrequencyForAdmins**<br><br>Ensures privileged sessions expire and re-authenticate periodically (e.g., every 4 hours). | **Principle 6: Session Management**<br><br>*"Constrain the duration and blast radius of active sessions on privileged interfaces."* | [NCSC Session Security](https://www.ncsc.gov.uk/guidance/zero-trust-architecture-point-6) | `terraform/conditional-access.tf` |
| **Policy Deployment Mode** | `MT.1090` | **NoConditionalAccessPoliciesInDisabledState**<br><br>Audits for abandoned or orphaned policies set to `disabled` instead of `report-only` or `enabled`. | **Principle 10: Operational Monitoring**<br><br>*"Maintain auditability and active posture governance across all policy definitions."* | [NCSC Auditability](https://www.ncsc.gov.uk/guidance/zero-trust-architecture-point-10) | `terraform/conditional-access.tf` |
